audit.why: 52.9% Emerald+ over 7218 games matches the data.
Poke-vs-burst lane: Karma chips and shields, Syndra holds the only hard kill threat. Early is a chip war, all-ins are Syndra's.
Syndra spikes at 2 (QE), 6 (execute R) and Luden's; Karma's Mantra exists from level 1, so her spike curve is flat — matches the text.
